## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return

      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }

## Objective
- Build a genuinely playable 3D Attack-on-Titan-inspired browser game, “TITAN SLAYER — ODM Combat,” in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, supporting desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- Multiple Titan types with AI that detects and chases players.
- Dual swords, lock-on, combos, equipment upgrades.
- Maps: city, walls, forest, grassland, wasteland.
- Modes: Story, Free Roam, Survival, Training, 4-player multiplayer.
- Missions: training, city defense, ally rescue, Titan elimination.
- Controls: left joystick, right-side camera/action buttons.
- Graphics presets: Low, Medium, High, Ultra, Extreme.
- FPS support 30–120.
- Optimized, smooth, low heat/lag.
- Critical: actual playable 3D movement, working ODM gear, functional Titan AI, every button functional.

## Decisions
- Static Three.js game with vendored Three r180 (`vendor/three/`), no build step, served as plain `index.html`.
- Procedural world/models/audio; no external assets or network dependency.
- Mobile 4P implemented as “BIỆT ĐỘI 4P” squad co-op: player + 3 AI allies, since static hosting cannot support real online multiplayer.
- UI language Vietnamese; dark cinematic red/steel visual theme.
- Graphics quality settings apply renderer resolution, shadows, fog, particle/grass visibility, and FPS cap live; geometry counts are fixed at world creation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, vendored Three.js, and full source modules:
  - `src/config.js`: quality presets, upgrades, Titan types, 5 story chapters, zones, tips, helpers.
  - `src/save.js`: localStorage progression/settings/upgrades/ranks.
  - `src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio SFX and ambient drone.
  - `src/input.js`: keyboard, pointer lock, mouse, touch joystick/camera/action buttons.
  - `src/world.js`: procedural city, wall/gate, forest, grassland, wasteland, mountains, sky, clouds, collisions, anchors, camera boom.
  - `src/models.js`: Titan and soldier models + soldier animation.
  - `src/entities.js`: Titan AI/states/attacks/death, TitanManager, AI Ally.
  - `src/player.js`: 3D movement, ODM grapple/swing physics, gas boost, jump/dodge, lock-on, combo combat, nape crits, damage/death, third-person camera.
  - `src/effects.js`: particles, steam, sparks, slash sprites, damage numbers, grapple line.
  - `src/ui.js`: menu, HUD, minimap, world markers, dialogue, settings/upgrades/story/controls/pause/result/briefing panels.
  - `src/game.js`: boot, renderer, loop/FPS cap, mode/mission orchestration, waves, free roam crystals, squad allies, rewards, pause/overlay flow.
- Added mobile interact button to action cluster.
- Added CSS for Titan world markers and touch interact button.
- Performed multiple post-write fixes: player Titan array access, minimap player/yaw handling, objective position updates, visited zones, gate reset, Titan gate waypointing, ground-height collision fix, sun-follow shadow target, restart reward handling, and result reward display.

### Active
- Static code review/debug pass is in progress; nothing has been run in a browser yet.
- Must verify the game loads, renders, starts missions, and controls work via Playwright.

### Blocked
- None currently.

## Next Move
1. Run a syntax/import check (e.g. `node --check` for each JS module) and fix errors.
2. Start the static server persistently (per project conventions) and open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`.
3. Inspect browser console/page errors; fix runtime issues.
4. Screenshot desktop and mobile views; verify menu, HUD, joystick/action buttons, 3D movement, ODM hook/swing, lock-on, combo attacks, Titan chase/attack, and mission completion.
5. Fix visual/layout issues (especially touch button overlap, marker placement, objective beacon).
6. Add/finish any missing functionality found during playtesting.
7. Commit changes only if appropriate for the workflow.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: all screens, HUD, touch controls, overlay container.
- `styles.css`: full responsive UI and touch layout.
- `src/game.js`: main orchestrator; most likely source of runtime bugs.
- `src/player.js`: movement/ODM/combat/camera logic.
- `src/entities.js`: Titan AI, TitanManager, Ally AI.
- `src/world.js`: procedural world, collisions, anchors, gate.
- `src/ui.js`: DOM/HUD/panels/minimap/markers/dialogue.
- `src/models.js`: procedural Titan/soldier meshes and animation.
- `src/input.js`: desktop/mobile input handling.
- `src/config.js`: balance, missions, upgrades, Titan stats.
- `src/save.js`: progression/settings persistence.
- `src/effects.js`: particles, slashes, damage numbers, grapple line.
- `src/audio.js`: procedural sound.
- `vendor/three/three.module.min.js`: Three.js module entry.
- `vendor/three/three.core.min.js`: required Three.js core dependency.

## Important Context
- No `package.json`; runtime serves `index.html` as a static site.
- Current working tree is uncommitted; git baseline is `cc93474`.
- `World.groundHeightAt` was changed to require the player’s center inside a collider, preventing accidental roof snapping.
- Titan gate pathing now routes outside Titans to waypoint `(0, 0, 214)` before targeting gate `(0, 0, 180)`.
- `Player.resolveHit` must use `this.game.titans.titans`, already fixed.
- `UI.drawMinimap` now accepts the player object (`p`) and handles `player.pos`/`player.yaw`.

- Story mission 5 kill objective has `excludeBoss: true`.
- Pointer lock is intentionally exited during dialogue/pause/results so overlay buttons remain clickable.

- Potential remaining runtime concerns: `Effects` custom ShaderMaterial attributes; `UI.panelResult` reward line; touch button positioning; `Titan.moveToward` collision side-step; `Player.update` air momentum; `Game.updateObjectives` defend-completion logic.

At the beginning of update, if hook active, onGround set false after physics, but before that, the player was grounded and vel.y = 0. updateHookPhysics: to has positive y, adds reel*dt to y, then gravity -19dt. With reel 15, net y acceleration = 15*(dy/dist) - 19. If anchor is high, dy/dist maybe 0.37 (22.7 / 61.6) → 5.5 - 19 = -13.5, so net downward! So the hook pulls mostly horizontally because reel 15 is weaker than gravity. That means the player can't lift off ground until they reach the building? But as they approach, dy/dist increases, eventually > 19/15=1.27 impossible (max 1). So vertical acceleration from reel is at most 15, always less than gravity 19. Thus the player never lifts off while hooked unless they jump first! That's a critical ODM bug. In AOT ODM, grappling should pull you up strongly. The reel should overcome gravity substantially, or gravity should be reduced while hooked.

Currently reel = 15 (normal) or 46 boost; boost can lift. But normal hook can't. Need to make normal reel stronger, e.g., 34 or 38, and maybe reduce gravity while hooked. Also max speed 58.
